title: Killa Frosted Mint Nic Pouches - 13.2mg / pouch
description: Killa Frosted Mint Nicotine Pouches provide a cool and refreshing mint flavour, perfect for those who prefer a classic, crisp taste paired with a balanced nicotine experience. Each pouch contains 13.2mg of nicotine, making it suitable for adult users who enjoy a steady and satisfying nicotine release. The Frosted Mint flavour offers a refreshing and smooth taste, delivering a long-lasting experience. These pouches are entirely tobacco-free, offering a clean and convenient alternative to traditional nicotine products. The discreet design of Killa Frosted Mint pouches makes them ideal for use in various settings, whether you're on the move, at work, or in a social environment where traditional nicotine use isn’t feasible. Killa Nicotine Pouches are crafted to deliver consistency and quality, ensuring a reliable nicotine experience. Simply place a pouch between your upper lip and gum, and enjoy a steady release of nicotine for up to 30 minutes. With 20 pouches per pack, Killa Frosted Mint offers a practical and refreshing option for those who enjoy a cool, minty twist while relieving nicotine cravings. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a steady nicotine release for up to 30min. 2 Place the used nicotine pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
